errors.text_span: 水平轴表示特殊句式类型...垂直轴表示数量
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the axes. The chart is a horizontal bar chart where the vertical axis lists the categories (特殊句式类型) and the horizontal axis represents the quantity (数量).
The description incorrectly transcribes a category label. The chart shows “省略动词” (Omission of Verb), but the description says “省略句式” (Omission of Sentence).
The description incorrectly transcribes a category label. The chart shows “状语后置” (Post-posed Adverbial), but the description says “状态后置” (Post-posed State).

The description fails to mention that the bars are sorted in ascending order of their values from top to bottom, which is a key organizational feature of the chart that the prompt asked to be included.
The description slightly misrepresents a category label. The chart shows “省略比喻词” (Omission of Simile Word), but the description shortens it to “省略比喻” (Omission of Simile).
The chart consists of horizontal bars, which have 'length' (长度), not 'height' (高度). This error is repeated throughout the description.
The description uses "约为" (approximately) to describe the values (e.g., "约为4"), but the chart provides exact numerical labels for each bar.
